question: Which of the following materials or elements is highly effective for making a permanent magnet?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Steel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Permanent magnet:

__
 
• Substances that at room temperature retain their ferromagnetic property for a long period of time are called permanent magnets.
 
• Permanent magnets can be made in the following ways:
 
 
• By holding an iron rod in the north-south direction and hammering it repeatedly.
 
• By holding a steel rod and stroke it with one end of a bar magnet a large number of times.
 
• An efficient way to make a permanent magnet is to place a ferromagnetic rod in a solenoid and pass a current.
 
 
 
• The hysteresis curve allows us to select suitable materials for permanent magnets.
 
• The hysteresis curve should be tall and wide for the material that is used to make a permanent magnet.
 
• The material that is used to make a permanent magnet should have high retentivity and high coercivity.
 
• Steel is a one-favored choice to make a permanent magnet.
 
• Other suitable materials for permanent magnets are alnico, cobalt steel, and ticonal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Zinc** is a chemical element with the symbol **Zn**.

 
 
• It is a** bluish- metal** that is not magnetic and has weak magnetic properties.
 
• It is commonly used in galvanizing to** protect iron and steel from corrosion**.
 
 
 
• **Aluminium **is a chemical element with the symbol **Al**.
 
 
• It is a **lightweight metal** that has weak magnetic properties.
 
• It is commonly used in the manufacturing of **aircraft, packaging, and electrical conductors**.
 
 
 
• **Copper **is a chemical element with the symbol **Cu**.
 
 
• It is a **reddish-brown metal** that has weak magnetic properties.
 
• It is commonly used in **electrical wiring, plumbing, and roofing**.
